decision.summary: Tenant says the landlord's LG washing machine is dead and offers to buy their own, which would stay theirs. This is a consent request, not a repair, so I asked the landlord, told the tenant, noted the file and put the job on hold until 30 July.

args.decision_needed: Tenant reports the LG washing machine (here when they moved in) has a power failure and, from their own web search, cannot be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property, not be on the inventory, and they would take it when they leave. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant fitting their own machine, (2) who pays to disconnect and remove the existing machine and fit the new one, (3) what should happen to your existing machine (inspect, repair, dispose), or would you rather we send our contractor to inspect it first?
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; tell us who pays for removal/fitting and what to do with the existing machine
Have our contractor inspect/repair the existing machine first
